data.key: Sentinel Boon ~ Alseta ~ Past and Future
data.name: Past and Future
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, you catch glimpses of the future that allow you to avoid your enemies' strikes. You gain improved uncanny dodge as a rogue of a level equal to your Hit Dice. If you already possess the improved uncanny dodge ability, or if you would gain it later, you instead gain a +2 sacred or profane bonus (of the same type as that provided by your obedience) on attack and damage rolls against creatures that are currently flanking you.
